description: Report the platform worktree's git status as structured lists. Runs a READ-ONLY 'git status --porcelain=v2 --branch' (the read-only git surface the GIT-CONTROLLER policy explicitly permits) with argv baked server-side, and parses it into {branch, staged, unstaged, untracked}. This verb NEVER mutates the repo or index — there is no add/commit/checkout path anywhere in this service. Use it to see what has changed before reading a diff or proposing a patch.
embedding_description: Show the git working-tree status of the platform repository: current branch plus staged, unstaged, and untracked path lists. Read-only porcelain-v2 parse; never mutates the index or tree. Use to see what changed before diffing or proposing a patch.

result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with the branch, then summarize counts and list the changed paths grouped by staged/unstaged/untracked.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Running a read-only 'git status --porcelain=v2 --branch' over the platform worktree with server-fixed argv.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: RepoToolError: the git subprocess timed out or exited non-zero (e.g. not a git worktree, or git unavailable). This is a read-only call; a failure is an environment problem, not a mutation.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm the solet is running from a git worktree with git installed. This verb takes no arguments; retry after the environment is healthy.
